name: StackOne
description: Connect AI agents to Workday, Salesforce, SAP and hundreds more business systems through one MCP gateway, with field-level permissions, prompt-injection defense and audit logs, for IT teams.

skills.name: Call Actions
skills.description: Calls pre-built actions in connected systems such as Workday, Salesforce and Slack for a linked account, over MCP or the SDK.

skills.name: Discover Tools
skills.description: Finds the relevant StackOne actions at runtime from a natural-language query instead of loading every tool up front.

skills.name: Deep Query
skills.description: Filters, searches and aggregates synced business data over MCP, returning only the counts or fields a task needs.

skills.name: Control Agent Actions
skills.description: Checks every agent action before it runs and allows, asks, masks or blocks each call according to policy.

skills.name: Detect Prompt Injection
skills.description: Scans tool results for indirect prompt injection with StackOne Defender before the content reaches the model.
